summary: Bonta's AG office reached a diversion agreement in September 2026 dismissing felony charges against five pro-Palestinian Stanford protesters, substituting community service and roughly $52,000 in restitution. CAIR Action endorsed him in the general election and Vote for Peace rated him an Ally.
